target: doctor.sh forge section — reports config and auto as the source when that is where the kind came from
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
fx_config '{"forge":{"kind":"github"}}'
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has config_kind 'github'
printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -F github | grep -Eqi 'config' && echo config_source=yes || echo config_source=no
rm -rf .agentic
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 200 '{"username":"x"}'
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has auto_kind 'gitlab'
printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -F gitlab | grep -Eqi 'auto' && echo auto_source=yes || echo auto_source=no
fx_done
